complete_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 인쇄·낭독 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민에게도 친근하되 성인 문화 행사에 어울리게 해줘. 생활문화센터와 커뮤니티의 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로, 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 고무판으로 종이에 찍는 작업과 그 인쇄물을 함께 읽는 행사가 연결되어 보이고, 일정·장소·입장·참가 조건·준비 안내가 읽혀야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

common_conditions: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

styles.exact_request: 덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 인쇄·낭독 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민에게도 친근하되 성인 문화 행사에 어울리게 해줘. 생활문화센터와 커뮤니티의 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로, 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 고무판으로 종이에 찍는 작업과 그 인쇄물을 함께 읽는 행사가 연결되어 보이고, 일정·장소·입장·참가 조건·준비 안내가 읽혀야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.
styles.invocation_interpretation: 덕테이프 포스터로 invokes this skill. It does not request physical tape, collage or a particular material. The user separately leaves style open.

own_direction.content_form: Two readers and a printing forearm gather around one title-bearing sheet on an oblique overhead table; useful information occupies clear upper/lower ledges.
own_direction.whole_expression_style: Saturated social illustration: engraved people and an elliptical table orient toward one centre. Square literary title, extended English and economical numbers contrast.
own_direction.reference_transfer: Canva: made objects and hand marks lower the participation barrier. Replace generic craft with one adult shared output, without portrait resizing. Mut’s making/gathering hierarchy becomes a table with large readable facts.

layout.large_relationship: A broad ellipse and three body/arm entries fill [61,130,606,199]. Title-bearing paper is central. Upper left combines date/time/place/entry; upper right holds English/activity. Fee/application and preparation/welcome share the lower ledge.
layout.alignment: Clean horizontal ledges start x28/x392 above and x28/x420 below. Central paper has horizontal title baselines; no curved text.
layout.visible_reading_route: First the shared title paper and attentive faces; next isolated upper-left date/time/place/entry answering attendance together. Then sweep the common lower baseline from fee/application to preparation/welcome. English/activity remains near the central event rather than a second headline.

typography.roles: Page title: clear square Korean serif 33 px, two lines. English: extended light capitals 19 px; activity open sans 18 px. Date/time tabular 20/23 px; venue/entry 18/17 px. Lower facts: regular sans 17 px. Engraved contours never break letter strokes.
typography.image_type_boundary: Title appears only on the shared paper. Texture avoids words; perimeter facts sit on unobstructed contrasting ground.

image.scene: Two adult heads/upper bodies enter above and from the right, both looking at the central page; one mouth reads aloud. A third adult forearm enters lower left and lifts a carved rubber slab beside the fresh impression on that same sheet.
image.action_relation: One continuous paper carries title and matching nonletter impression. Rubber underside, adjacent print, slab thickness, lifting gap and clean-edge fingers remain distinct. The two readers’ gaze converges on the actual supplied title; no invented page words.
image.crop: Retain adult eyes/mouths, shoulders and continuing forearm. Heads 65–75 px; block/imprint 55–65 px. Avoid overhead framing that reduces reading to hands alone.

own_direction.material: Contemporary flat drawing with angular carved contours. Nontext ink cuts communicate transfer; exact type stays crisp, without antique-paper simulation.
own_direction.color: Burnt-orange table, indigo people/contours, pale lilac outer ground and light central sheet. Warm gathering mass contrasts with cool fact ledges.
own_direction.emotion: Companionable, active adult participation; social scale supplies welcome rather than cute motifs.

copy_groups.line_plan: 2 lines; break after word 1; 39 px step; widest ≈132 px.
4 rows with 24–26 px boxes; widest ≈197 px.

nearest_direction_difference.stripped_material_color_test: M3 retains an oblique elliptical table, smaller heads and facts on perimeter ledges. M5 retains a tall frontal page, huge opposing face crops and every fact inside it. Viewpoint, people distribution, text boundary and retrieval remain different without colour/material.

scope: One isolated assigned poster; no peer or critic access; no agents spawned.
